title: Psionics as part of the Cold War retrieval and reverse-engineering program

tellings.quote: go back to GR and Carl subroa cold war to retrieve or reverse engineer this stuff. Well, the psionics part is a part of that retrieval program and reverse engineering program.

plain: Research into psionics, meaning powers of the mind such as telepathy, was part of a secret Cold War program to recover and reverse engineer (take apart and copy) unexplained technology, according to the researcher Matthew Pines. He tells Michels this as his own reading, naming no source. If it were true, the government's mind research and its alleged study of strange craft would be one project, not two.
